verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into her and let Test of Spirit tick; you win if you burst her the instant her E and W are both down.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) turns a lost trade into free healing: if you're hit and can't kill the spirit or break the tether before it expires, you become a Vessel spawning tentacles that hit you and heal her. Riven has no way to cleanse or outrange that threat, only to avoid it, so this matchup is won by denying stand-and-trade windows, not winning them.

theirWindow.when: She lands E (Test of Spirit) on you
theirWindow.what: Kill the spirit or get far enough away that the tether breaks before it expires. If it isn't broken you become a Vessel and nearby tentacles start hitting you and healing her every second you're tagged.

yourWindow.when: Her E and W are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your only safe all-in window. Dash in with E (Valor), stun with W (Ki Burst), and dump Q (Broken Wings) charges before she can threaten another Test of Spirit or Harsh Lesson leap.

start.why: 93.1% pick rate at 46.5% win rate — the extra sustain and damage matter because you need to win short trades outright, not grind her down over time.

boots.why: 66.5% pick, 49.3% win rate. The ability haste tightens your Q (Broken Wings) and E (Valor) windows so you can re-engage the instant her E and W are both down.

core.why: 73.1% win rate on this path. The shield from the shred passive absorbs the exact burst — Harsh Lesson plus a tentacle swing — that she uses to open trades.
Sustain damage and healing that offsets the chip from tentacles and Tentacle Smash poke while you wait for your all-in window.
Converts her burst damage into a damage-over-time tick instead of a lump hit, so a bad trade near a tentacle doesn't outright kill you.
Armor shred speeds up how fast you can end a fight, which matters because every extra second in combat is another tentacle hit and heal for her.

situational.when: her tentacle and passive healing are keeping her alive through your all-ins
you want faster E (Valor) and R (Blade of Exile) resets to force a second burst window in the same fight
her auto attacks and tentacle procs are chunking you faster than Ionian's haste is helping you punish

runes.keystoneWhy: You need stacks built before you commit, since this is the only way your short burst window outweighs her sustained tentacle damage and healing.

summoners.why: 97.4% pick rate at 46.9% win rate. Ignite's grievous wounds directly answers the tentacle and passive healing that otherwise lets her win extended trades.

playing.title: Never stand in Test of Spirit
playing.detail: The instant she tags you with E, either kill the spirit or disengage far enough to break the tether before it expires. Getting converted to a Vessel means tentacles hit and heal her for free.

playing.title: Trade in one burst, not auto exchanges
playing.detail: Dump Q (Broken Wings), W (Ki Burst), and E (Valor) in one combo rather than trading autos — standing and auto-trading lets her passive tentacles and Harsh Lesson stack damage onto you.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassable terrain, so pulling fights into open lane denies her the extra tentacle swings that turn an even trade into a losing one.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown to time all-ins
playing.detail: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s. Once it's down and her W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) has also just been used, that's your safest window to commit with R (Blade of Exile) up.

playing.title: Use R as a burst cooldown, not a duel tool
playing.detail: Blade of Exile's attack damage and range spike is strongest as the finisher in your pre-planned all-in, not something to save for a 1v1 she can out-sustain.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal the moment sustain swings
playing.detail: If her tentacle and passive healing start keeping her alive through your combos, prioritize Executioner's Calling immediately rather than waiting for your next full back.

playing.title: Use E (Valor) to disengage, not just dash in
playing.detail: Valor blocks incoming damage on the way out too — use it to cleanly exit a trade that's turned into a vessel-conversion risk instead of committing further.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning about Test of Spirit, tentacle placement, and trade timing is this brief's own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Illaoi’s (E). Purchase items that reduce healing, and engage when your Conqueror’s stacks are raised to gain an advantage.
